info.title: Fourletters API - Hub (WebSocket)
info.description: Hub is a live relay. Clients open a WebSocket to receive already-accepted, E2E-encrypted payloads pushed by the Server via RabbitMQ, and to exchange ephemeral control frames (presence, typing, call signaling). Messages are never sent through the Hub.

/ws.description: WebSocket channel for the fourletters Hub. The client authenticates with its Access JWT

subscribe.summary: Client receives a live payload from the Hub
subscribe.description: Relays a live payload to the client: a new message, a delivery/read/undecryptable notification, a contact's presence/typing state, a pong, or a call signal from a call peer.

publish.summary: Client sends a control frame to the Hub
publish.description: These are the only frames the Hub acts on. Presence subscribe/unsubscribe manage which contacts' live state the client receives; typing announces the sender is typing; ping is an application-level liveness probe answered by a pong; call_signal relays an ephemeral, E2E-encrypted call signal to a call peer (never stored).
